Mr. Gerald Salines, a native of Hempstead, Texas, and a graduate of Prairie View A&M, began his teaching career in 1965.
He became a beloved History and Government teacher, as well as a Cross Country coach. Throughout his career, he taught
at Charlton-Pollard High School, Beaumont High, Beaumont Charlton Pollard High, and Central Senior High School. He
retired in 2024 from Minnie Rogers Juvenile Justice Center (BISD) after 55 years of service. His passion for Black History and
the Civil Rights Movement allowed him to inspire the next generation to strive for change.
Photo from the 1966 Charlton-Pollard yearbook, and the Tyrrell Historical Library Archives.
Photo provided by Jessie Davis..
